verdict.rationale: ADK is itself an official, first-party Python SDK/framework from Google with extensive docs covering agent construction, tools, workflows, deployment, and CLI usage, plus an active open-source GitHub repo (google/adk-python) demonstrating real APIs like `adk run` and Task API. This directly satisfies building against an official SDK for agentic development. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration beyond Google's own docs/repo, and no evidence of SDKs in other languages beyond Python.
